preamble: The Common Slavic back nasal vowel *ǫ (Old Church Slavonic ѫ) lost its nasality and unrounded in Bulgarian to the mid back unrounded vowel ъ [ɤ], merging with the reflex of the strong back yer (Sussex & Cubberley 2006). In the eastern dialects the back nasal came to be pronounced like ъ, and the pre-1945 spelling still wrote ѫ in зѫбъ, пѫть and мѫжъ, now зъб, път and мъж. East Slavic, Czech and Serbo-Croatian instead raised *ǫ to u.
